chapter: The Original Dixieland band to California
title: Assembling the band in Houston
summary: In Houston the group included Victor Spencer, trumpet and trombone Gus Dulus, an old Texas trumpeter and pianist Scanley.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: So then when you got to Houston...

When we got to Houston, they had... Victor Spencer was there, and we had a Portuguese guy named Gus Dulus(?) who was playing trumpet. Well, these are no (?) musicians... They had a guy...a trumpet player named Lee something, an old man...he was from Texas, but he couldn't... He played probably something like that old trumpet player who played with the Preservation Hall Band, who was awful... Willie Humphrey's brother.
Percy. Something like that. And they had a banjo player, I can't think of his name...
This is all with the band that you went to the West Coast with.
That was the band that worked up to the West Coast.
Yeah, that's the band that we put together. I'm trying to remember all the guys that was in the band. How many pieces was it... Well, Gus played the trombone; he also played trumpet.
What was the name of the band? Do you remember?
That was the band that Bespawn(?) and Hills...the Original Dixieland Band.

See, Toby Mitchell was organizing that band for Bespawn(?) and Hill. And then they was also inn Houston, waiting for him, because he had went to New Orleans to try to pick up some musicians. And I don't think he tried very hard as he probably could... I think he took the money and spent it all there. Anyway, he got me and he got Vic, and when we got to Houston he got a good piano player
named Scanley(?) something. And who else on trombone...? They had a tuba player, too, but I can't think of his name. We wasn't together that long either, anyway.
